items.rationale: Reread nOtp delegation and the actual token generation/validation pipelines, not only OTP configuration. sourceFindings: DefaultOtpService stamps OTP generation and delegates to nToken; the handler uses crypto.randomInt with an exclusive upper bound and expiry seconds.
Generation defaults model.limit from token.TOKEN.attemptLimit, not OTP.attemptLimit, and can reuse an existing active unexpired key/ops token.
Validation looks up active key/ops, accepts expiry at or after now and compares string values; it does not add an OTP-type predicate in the inspected lookup.
Validation calls process.nextSuccess/error before updating limit/deactivation, does not await persistence and only logs update failure; concurrent verification can pass twice or lose decrements.
No delivery, resend cooldown, account rate/lockout or challenge audit orchestration is present in the OTP service call path.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: OTP_ATOMICITY_GAP: intended singleUseToken/decrement flags do not provide atomic consume/attempt enforcement or guaranteed persisted lockout.

No OTP generation/validation, raw code, security test or live acceptance was performed.

items.rationale: The guide distinguishes implemented controlled SMTP from injected email/SMS sandbox ports and explicitly refuses a live-certification shortcut. Retry scheduling is not advertised as an automatic worker, and business-domain completion remains separate from communication delivery. Those are the requested provider, template, retry, failure-evidence and extension explanations, supported by current source rather than just package names.
sourceFindings: Communication runtime owns persisted attempt/lease/outcome projection. A new resolveUncertain decision requires current expectedRevision, explicit confirmation/reason/operator and MARK_DELIVERED/AUTHORIZE_RESEND/CANCEL; exact original revision/action/reason/operator replay is read-only and never sends or appends a second decision.

Configured source eligibility is frozen into intent identity and rechecked read-only before claim and before transport using bound tenant/source/recipient evidence. Template resources now also support TELEGRAM/IN_APP without changing the guide's EMAIL/SMS behavior.
Retry uses persisted state and refuses uncertain or exhausted sends; delivery failure does not reset an owning domain operation.
Template service validates owner-contained resources, declared typed variables, locale fallback, bounded content and safe HTML/URL rendering.
SMTP has controlled Nodemailer transport plus injected sandbox mode; SMS uses injected transport with bounded UTF-8 text and rejects HTML, not an implemented live carrier.
correctnessAndCoverageLimitations: The SMS maximumContentBytes prose has a malformed range/list break, leaving its upper bound unclear; repair that small presentation defect against the provider's 65536-byte configuration ceiling. This does not negate the requested implemented-mode/retry/security explanation.

The guide is not an exhaustive state/replay protocol: runtime intent expiry is CANCELLED while the table groups expiry with suppression prevention; exact lost-ack replay and source eligibility are detailed in owner contracts and focused tests.
No emails/SMS were sent and no provider credentials, endpoint behavior, deliverability or signed-in operator flow was accepted in this review.
